text: {"rules":[{"id":"AAA-SCREEN-M-65-75-SMOKER","version":"December 2019","title":"Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm: Screening: men aged 65 to 75 years who have ever smoked","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends 1-time screening for abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) with ultrasonography in men aged 65 to 75 years who have ever smoked.","grade":"B","effective_date":"December 2019","action":"One-time abdominal aortic aneurysm screening with ultrasonography","denominator":"{\"all\": [{\"age\": {\"min\": 65, \"max\": 75, \"at\": \"end\"}, \"quote\": \"men aged 65 to 75 years\"}, {\"sex\": {\"is\": \"M\"}, \"quote\": \"men\"}, {\"condition\": {\"concept\": \"ever_smoker\", \"onset_by\": \"{MY}-12-31\"}, \"quote\": \"who have ever smoked\", \"note\": \"Relies on structured smoking-history (ever smoker) data being recorded\"}], \"quote\": \"men aged 65 to 75 years who have ever smoked\"}","numerator":"{\"procedure\": {\"concept\": \"aaa_ultrasound\", \"window\": [\"{MY-10}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"1-time screening for abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) with ultrasonography\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"1-time screening means any screening since the patient became eligible at 65; the oldest eligible patient (75 at end of MY) turned 65 during MY-10, so a window starting {MY-10}-01-01 captures any screening done since age 65\"}}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["The numerator lookback window ({MY-10}-01-01 to {MY}-12-31) is derived from the age range and the 'one-time' wording, not stated in the text; it requires human review. A screen done before age 65 would not count under this window.","The rule uses the ever_smoker concept, so it relies on structured smoking history. Patients with missing or unrecorded smoking status will not enter the denominator.","The rule has no repeat-screening logic. The text says the screening is 1-time and gives no follow-up intervals for abnormal results.","The DATE field carries an asterisk ('December 2019 *'); the footnote it refers to is not in the section text and is not represented.","USPSTF recommendations for men who have never smoked (grade C) and for women are not in this section and are not encoded."]}
